Gujarat University vs Nirma University for M.Sc is a state university compared with a private university. Both have a recorded 2023 year. The recorded highest packages match at ₹15 lakh. Nirma has the higher recorded average and the higher recorded year tuition.

sections.heading: Gujarat University vs Nirma University for M.Sc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Nirma University if you want the higher recorded 2023 average, at ₹10 lakh, with a highest of ₹15 lakh, and can budget recorded tuition of ₹2 lakh a year.
Choose Gujarat University if a lower recorded year-wise total of ₹1.11 lakh matters, with 2023 figures of a ₹9 lakh average and a ₹15 lakh highest package.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Gujarat University has a recorded year-wise total of ₹1.11 lakh for M.Sc programmes on this page. State university fees can vary by department. Confirm the official notice of the teaching department.
Nirma University has recorded tuition of ₹2 lakh a year. Treat both figures as recorded year fees, not confirmed programme totals, until you check the official circulars.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

Nirma's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹10 lakh and a highest package of ₹15 lakh. Gujarat University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹9 lakh and a highest of ₹15 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. M.Sc admissions may use bachelor's marks or a university admission test, depending on the department.
Read the current official admissions page of each university for eligibility and specialisations.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different sites. Gujarat University is the state university. Nirma is a private university on the Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway.
Visit the teaching department you will join, because science programmes can sit on more than one campus.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On recorded 2023 averages, Nirma University is slightly ahead, at ₹10 lakh against Gujarat University's ₹9 lakh. The recorded highest packages match at ₹15 lakh.
On recorded year fees, Gujarat University is lower, at ₹1.11 lakh against Nirma's ₹2 lakh.
Confirm both official circulars for the specialisation you will join before you decide.
